summary: Verification-only pass for two UI fixes: (1) Main Menu category tab strip hard-placement across mobile/tablet/desktop and (2) TrustMarquee (brand-badge marquee) full-width + readable + seamless loop. All 7 requested bullets PASS.

menu_tabs_mobile_390x844.evidence: Container .menu-category-text--on-hero clientWidth=390, scrollWidth=390 (no overflow). overflowX/Y='hidden', justifyContent='space-between'. All 4 tabs visible (offsetParent!==null) with identical widths of 91.5px each. Right edges: 103.5, 195, 286.5, 378 — all <=390. document.scrollWidth=390 (no horizontal page scroll). Confirmed for every active tab state (Raw Dog Food, Raw Dog Treats, Raw Cat Food, Raw Cat Treats).

menu_tabs_tablet_768x1024.evidence: container clientWidth=720 == scrollWidth=720. All 4 tabs each 174px wide. Right edges 210/384/558/732 — all inside viewport 768. overflow:hidden, justify:space-between confirmed.

menu_tabs_desktop_1440x900.evidence: clientWidth=1036 == scrollWidth=1036. All 4 tabs each exactly 253px. Right edges 467/720/973/1226 — all <=1440. Clicking 'Raw Dog Treats' does NOT cause any cutoff; layout stays identical across all 4 active states.

menu_tab_equal_distribution.evidence: Desktop tab widths: [253, 253, 253, 253]. max/min = 1.00 (well within 1.35 tolerance). Same equal distribution observed on mobile (91.5 each) and tablet (174 each) due to flex:1 1 0.

marquee_full_width.evidence: .trust-marquee-outer clientWidth === window.innerWidth on all viewports (390==390, 768==768, 1440==1440). Bounding rect left=0, right=viewport width. Container spans full width.

marquee_readable_image_heights.evidence: getComputedStyle(.trust-marquee-img).height = '60px' on mobile 390, '74px' on tablet 768, '88px' on desktop 1440. Matches spec thresholds exactly.

marquee_seamless_loop.evidence: animation computed = '9s/12s linear infinite marquee' with @keyframes translateX(0)->translateX(-50%). Track duplicates badges exactly once (imgCount=10 for 5 unique badges). Transform observed changing over time: mobile t0=-155.6 -> t+3s=-25.6 (wrapped through -50%); desktop t0=-423.9 -> t+3s=-603.9 (continuous). Screenshot confirms badges rotate continuously with even spacing and no visible large gap.

test_notes: Minor test observation (not a product bug): on mobile/tablet the funnel modal reappears sometimes after category click and can intercept a subsequent tab click, so the visual 'is-active' class did not always update in the Playwright run. Since tab layout is driven by flex:1 1 0 and is independent of active state, positioning still verifies correctly across every state.

Marquee getBoundingClientRect on the track element reported width == viewport width even though CSS is `width: max-content` — this is likely a measurement quirk (bounding rect + overflow-hidden ancestor). The visual screenshot and observed transform delta both confirm the marquee content is wider than viewport and animates smoothly, so this is not a functional issue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Menu tab strip uses flex:1 1 0 with justify-content:space-between and overflow:hidden on .menu-category-text--on-hero, giving hard-placed equal tabs on all viewports. TrustMarquee (LandingPage.js lines 453-540) duplicates badges once and animates translateX(0) -> translateX(-50%) with viewport-scaled image heights 60/74/88px.
